rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: See? Just like I said--there's no military scum around here after all!
rows.display_text:
「See? Just like I said--there's no
military scum around here after all!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: That's weird... I could've sworn I saw a mobile suit go into town.
rows.display_text:
「That's weird... I could've sworn a mobile
suit went into town.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Anyway, now's the time to strike! Let's tear this town apart and take every last thing they've got!
rows.display_text:
「Anyway, now's the time to strike! Let's
tear this town apart and take everything
they've got!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: All right! First squad, charge!
rows.display_text: 「All right! First squad, charge!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: A pitfall!?
rows.display_text: 「A pitfall!?」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: Now, everyone! Fire! FIRE!!
rows.display_text: 「Now, everyone! Fire! FIRE!!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Th-the first squad's been wiped out!
rows.display_text: 「Th-the first squad's been wiped out!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: You bastards! You think you can take us on with nothing but hand-held weapons!?
rows.display_text:
「You bastards! Think you can take us on
with nothing but hand-held weapons!?」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Don't underestimate us! I'll show you being outlaws ain't just for show!
rows.display_text:
「Don't underestimate us! I'll show you
being outlaws ain't just for show!」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: All right! Everyone, fall back! We'll leave the rest to our bodyguards!
rows.display_text:
「All right! Everyone, fall back! Leave the
rest to our bodyguards!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Wh-what the hell!?
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what the hell!?」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: These townsfolk went and hired themselves some backup!
rows.display_text:
「These townsfolk went and hired
themselves some backup!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Sijou, Hex, Septe--disrupt the enemy from the air.
rows.display_text:
「Sijou, Hex, Septe--disrupt the enemy
from the air.」

rows.speaker: Sijou
rows.en: Understood, Leader. I'll show them the power of the Murasame.
rows.display_text:
「Understood, Leader. I'll show them the
power of the Murasame.」

rows.speaker: Hex
rows.en: There's a good wave coming in...! Let's do this!
rows.display_text:
「There's a good wave coming in...! Let's
do this!」

rows.speaker: Septe
rows.en: Don't think a Walker Machine can keep up with a device's speed!
rows.display_text:
「Don't think a Walker Machine can keep
up with a device's speed!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Zwei, Cinq--rear support! Trois, you're with me!
rows.display_text:
「Zwei, Cinq--rear support! Trois, you're
with me!」

rows.speaker: Zwei
rows.en: R-roger! Please clear the line of fire!
rows.display_text: 「R-roger! Please clear the line of fire!」

rows.speaker: Cinq
rows.en: Times like this, I'm glad the Dobeck's got range.
rows.display_text:
「Times like this, I'm glad the Dobeck's
got range.」

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: Well then... shall we get to it?
rows.display_text: 「Well then... shall we get to it?」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Damn it! Keep firing! Tear this town to pieces!!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it! Keep firing! Tear this town to
pieces!!」

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: You bastard...! Going out in a blaze of desperation, huh!
rows.display_text:
「You bastard...! Out in a blaze of
desperation, huh!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: All units, begin attack! Don't forget--the center of the world is right behind us!!
rows.display_text:
「All units, attack! Don't forget--the
center of the world is right behind us!!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: That's...!
rows.display_text: 「That's...!」

rows.speaker: Hex
rows.en: What are you doing, Leader!
rows.display_text: 「What are you doing, Leader!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: I've spotted a resident who couldn't get away in time! I'm moving to rescue her now!
rows.display_text:
「I've spotted a resident who couldn't
get away! I'm moving to rescue her now!」

rows.speaker: Girl
rows.en: A... aah...

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: It's all right, miss. There's nothing to worry about now.
rows.display_text:
「It's all right, miss. There's nothing to
worry about now.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: You're the one who oughta be worried!
rows.display_text: 「You're the one who oughta be worried!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Gah!!
rows.display_text: 「Gah!!」

rows.speaker: Zwei
rows.en: Leader!!
rows.display_text: 「Leader!!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: What an idiot! Worrying about somebody else at a time like this!
rows.display_text:
「What an idiot! Worrying about somebody
else at a time like this!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: But I ain't gonna kill you quick. I'll crush you nice and slow, right along with that brat you tried to protect!
rows.display_text:
「But I ain't killing you quick. I'll crush
you slow, right along with that brat you
tried to protect!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Lose to the likes of you...!? I won't! I refuse to lose!
rows.display_text:
「Lose to you...!? I won't! I refuse to
lose!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Nice bluff! C'mon now... at least save yourself and run. Just leave the brat behind.
rows.display_text:
「Nice bluff! C'mon... at least save
yourself and run. Leave the brat behind.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: I won't be a coward again...! I won't run from what I have to do!
rows.display_text:
「I won't be a coward again...! I won't
run from what I have to do!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Ain't that just so cool! But you're way too soft for your own good!
rows.display_text:
「Ain't that just so cool! But you're way
too soft for your own good!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: This is the kind of world we live in! Nobody gives a damn about somebody else's life!
rows.display_text:
「This is the world we live in! Nobody
gives a damn about someone else's life!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: ...Maybe you're right about that...
rows.display_text: 「...Maybe you're right about that...」

rows.speaker: Cinq
rows.en: Leader...
rows.display_text: 「Leader...」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: I used to be that kind of man too... Fighting only on orders, taking other people's lives whenever it served that purpose...
rows.display_text:
「I was that kind of man too... Fighting
only on orders, taking lives whenever it
served that end...」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: But I'm a human being...! I don't want to throw away my own judgment and become nothing but a machine that just follows orders!
rows.display_text:
「But I'm human...! I won't throw away my
judgment and become a mere
order-following machine!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Wh-what's this!? You starting some kind of confession now!?
rows.display_text:
「Wh-what's this!? Starting some kind of
confession now!?」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: That's why I left the military...! Even if I'm still going to fight, I wanted to fight by my own will!
rows.display_text:
「That's why I left the military...! Even
if I still fight, I want to fight by my
own will!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: If I ran away now, after all that, there'd be no place left for me in this world!
rows.display_text:
「If I ran away now, there'd be no place
left for me in this world!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Sh-shut up! Get crushed and die!!
rows.display_text: 「Sh-shut up! Get crushed and die!!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Heh... thanks for humoring my little sob story.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... thanks for humoring my little sob
story.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: What!?
rows.display_text: 「What!?」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: While that was going on, the young lady got herself rescued by an angel.
rows.display_text:
「Meanwhile, the young lady got herself
rescued by an angel.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: It's all right now, dear.
rows.display_text: 「It's all right now, dear.」

rows.speaker: Girl
rows.en: But what about the mister!
rows.display_text: 「But what about the mister!」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: There's nothing to worry about.
rows.display_text: 「There's nothing to worry about.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Big O, Showtime!
rows.display_text: 「Big O, Showtime!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Wh-what is that!? That huge thing!?
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what is that!? That huge thing!?」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: A Negotiator...?
rows.display_text: 「A Negotiator...?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: No... that's not it.
rows.display_text: 「No... that's not it.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Having actively intervened in this battle, the name of Negotiator no longer suits me. Today, I'm nothing more than a busybody.
rows.display_text:
「Having jumped into this fight, I'm no
longer a Negotiator. Today, I'm just a
busybody.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: You bastard! Don't screw with me!
rows.display_text: 「You bastard! Don't screw with me!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Understood. As proof I'm not playing around, I'll crush you with everything I've got.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. As proof I'm not playing,
I'll crush you with everything I've got.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Wh-what... th-that's...! No way!
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what... th-that's...! No way!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Sorry about this, Roger Smith.
rows.display_text: 「Sorry about this, Roger Smith.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: No need to thank me. I'm just a busybody, after all.
rows.display_text:
「No need to thank me. I'm just a
busybody, after all.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's how it is. I'll go all out, then!
rows.display_text: 「That's how it is. I'll go all out, then!」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Master Roger, the bandit gang has been wiped out, and the survivors have all fled.
rows.display_text:
「Master Roger, the bandit gang's wiped
out, and the survivors have all fled.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I see. The town should have peace now.
rows.display_text: 「I see. The town should have peace now.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: You saved us, Roger. You might turn it down, but let me thank you properly all the same.
rows.display_text:
「You saved us, Roger. You might refuse
it, but let me thank you properly all the
same.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Mister Oone, that story you told Breaker...
rows.display_text:
「Mister Oone, that story you told
Breaker...」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Don't take it seriously. I told you it was just a sob story, didn't I?
rows.display_text:
「Don't take it seriously. It was just a
sob story, I told you.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: But there's one thing I swore to myself after I left the military.
rows.display_text:
「But there's one thing I swore after I
left the military.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: That I'd fight by my own will, so I could live like a human being.
rows.display_text:
「To fight by my own will, so I could
live like a human being.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: So that's the way of life you all found.
rows.display_text:
「So that's the way of life you all
found.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Let's pull out, everyone! Rough-and-tumble bodyguards don't belong in a peaceful town!
rows.display_text:
「Pull out, everyone! Rough-and-tumble
bodyguards don't belong in a peaceful
town!」

rows.speaker: Hex
rows.en: Got it, Leader. So, where to next?
rows.display_text: 「Got it, Leader. So, where to next?」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Who knows... But don't forget this much.
rows.display_text:
「Who knows... But don't forget this
much.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Wherever we go, the ground we're standing on with our own two feet is the center of the world.
rows.display_text:
「Wherever we go, the ground we stand on
with our own two feet is the center of
the world.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Come on, then, bandits! Don't think you can take down a man who's made up his mind that easily!
rows.display_text:
「Come on, bandits! Don't think you can
take down a man who's made up his mind
that easily!」

rows.speaker: Zwei
rows.en: Lady Dianna... I've left the Dianna Counter, but I think of the Moon always.
rows.display_text:
（Lady Dianna... I left the Dianna
Counter, but I always think of the Moon.）

rows.speaker: Zwei
rows.en: That's why I'm traveling with everyone, searching for a place where the Moonrace can return.
rows.display_text:
（That's why I travel with everyone,
searching for a place where the Moonrace
can return.）

rows.speaker: Zwei
rows.en: That's exactly why I can't afford to go down in a place like this! I'll win this fight, no matter what!
rows.display_text:
（That's exactly why I can't go down in
a place like this! I'll win this fight, no
matter what!）

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: I like it, you guys. Wearing your feelings and desires right out in the open.
rows.display_text:
「I like it, you guys. Feelings and desires
worn right out in the open.」

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: You're not gonna find guys like these holed up in a PLANT.
rows.display_text:
「You won't find guys like these holed up
in a PLANT.」

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: Well... if anything, I'm closer to your kind these days! So I'm coming at you without holding back!
rows.display_text:
「Well... if anything, I'm closer to your
kind these days! I'm coming at you
without holding back!」

rows.speaker: Sijou
rows.en: My homeland, Orb, was once an ideal nation where Naturals and Coordinators coexisted.
rows.display_text:
「My homeland, Orb, was an ideal nation
where Naturals and Coordinators coexisted.」

rows.speaker: Sijou
rows.en: That ideal still lives on inside me, even now...!
rows.display_text:
「That ideal still lives on inside me, even
now...!」

rows.speaker: Sijou
rows.en: That's why I will never forgive those who trample others underfoot to satisfy their own greed, like you!
rows.display_text:
「That's why I'll never forgive those who
trample others underfoot for their own
greed, like you!」

rows.speaker: Cinq
rows.en: Promotions and bonuses don't matter to me. If there's no track laid out, I'll build my own road.
rows.display_text:
「Promotions and bonuses don't matter to
me. With no track laid out, I'll build my
own road.」

rows.speaker: Cinq
rows.en: Making a living is tough work. ...That's exactly why I'm going to treasure this life and give it everything I've got!
rows.display_text:
「Making a living is tough. ...That's
exactly why I'll treasure this life and
give it everything I've got!」

rows.speaker: Hex
rows.en: When it comes to Lift boarding, it's gotta be free, no matter what!
rows.display_text:
「When it comes to Lift boarding, it's
gotta be free, period!」

rows.speaker: Hex
rows.en: If you guys had ridden Trapar too, you wouldn't have had to pull some dumb stunt like becoming bandits!
rows.display_text:
「If you'd ridden Trapar too, you
wouldn't have pulled some dumb stunt like
becoming bandits!」

rows.speaker: Septe
rows.en: I might just be some deserter now, but I used to be an ace with the Singularity Search Unit!
rows.display_text:
「I might be just some deserter now, but
I used to be an ace with the Singularity
Search Unit!」

rows.speaker: Septe
rows.en: You think some run-of-the-mill bandits can take down someone trained by the military like me!?
rows.display_text:
「You think some run-of-the-mill bandits
can take down someone military-trained
like me!?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Freedom... Those seven, and the people of this town too--they're all living true to their own hearts.
rows.display_text:
（Freedom... Those seven, and the
townsfolk too--they're all living true to
their own hearts.）

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I should follow their example too, if I'm going to live on in this chaotic world.
rows.display_text:
（I should follow their lead too, if I'm
to live on in this chaotic world.）

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: ...The multiverse, being an assembly of many different worlds, naturally gathers its people from just as many different worlds.
rows.display_text:
「...The multiverse, an assembly of many
worlds, naturally draws its people from
just as many worlds.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Kamille and I come from the same world, while Kappei and Shinn and the others are from a different one.
rows.display_text:
「Kamille and I are from the same
world; Kappei and Shinn and the rest are
from a different one.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Besides that, there's also Mimsy and the others from Emaan, and Jiron and Marin and the rest, who come from a world way out of sync in time.
rows.display_text:
「There's also Mimsy and the others from
Emaan, plus Jiron and Marin, from a world
way out of sync in time.」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: Even within $c alone, this many people have gathered from all these different worlds.
rows.display_text:
「Even within $c alone, this many people
have gathered from so many different
worlds.」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: You can imagine what the situation must be like across the whole world.
rows.display_text:
「You can imagine what it's like across
the whole world.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's right... And whenever people from different standpoints gather, conflict is born, big or small.
rows.display_text:
「That's right... Whenever people from
different standpoints gather, conflict is
born, big or small.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: From disputes between individuals to a full-scale war splitting the world in two--the forms it takes vary widely.
rows.display_text:
「From disputes between individuals to a
war splitting the world in two--the forms
it takes vary widely.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: A small town I stopped by during my travels was also caught in the middle of a conflict.
rows.display_text:
「A small town I stopped by during my
travels was caught in a conflict too.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: What... For something about the center of the world, this sounds like a pretty plain story.
rows.display_text:
「What... For something about the center
of the world, this sounds like a plain
story.」

rows.speaker: Boss
rows.en: I get it! So that's when you sided with one of them and beat the other side to a pulp!
rows.display_text:
「I get it! So you sided with one of
them and beat the other side to a pulp!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: I see. So you went and fought it out flashily in the Big O.
rows.display_text:
「I see. So you went and fought it out
flashily in the Big O.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I'm no bodyguard, and no mercenary either. I'm a Negotiator.
rows.display_text:
「I'm no bodyguard, no mercenary either.
I'm a Negotiator.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I'm used to it by now, but to be misunderstood right down to the very end...
rows.display_text:
「I'm used to it, but to be misunderstood
right to the very end...」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: I know that, Mister Negotiator.
rows.display_text: 「I know that, Mister Negotiator.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: It's just that, for some reason, every job that comes your way ends up turning into that kind of thing in the end.
rows.display_text:
「It's just that every job that comes
your way somehow ends up turning into
that kind of thing in the end.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: It might sound like an excuse, but that's not my doing. All I can say is my luck was bad.
rows.display_text:
「It may sound like an excuse, but that's
not my doing. My luck was just bad.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Man, you're killing me. Skip the work complaints and just get on with the story already.
rows.display_text:
「Man, you're killing me. Skip the work
complaints and get on with the story.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Understood. I've no intention of putting on a gloomy story at a time like this myself, either.
rows.display_text:
「Understood. I've no intention of telling
a gloomy story at a time like this,
either.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: ...That was during the time between when I parted ways with Banjo and the others at Bellforest, and when I rejoined the Iron Gear.
rows.display_text:
「...That was between parting with Banjo
and the others at Bellforest, and
rejoining the Iron Gear.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I received a request to negotiate from a small town that was being subjected to a bandit gang's unreasonable demands...
rows.display_text:
「I received a request to negotiate from
a small town being subjected to a bandit
gang's unreasonable demands...」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: ...So, what? You gonna be the one bringing us the town's tribute money?
rows.display_text:
「...So what? You bringing us the town's
tribute money, then?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: As I explained a moment ago, I've come here to tell you that the town refuses to pay that money.
rows.display_text:
「As I explained, I've come here to tell
you the town refuses to pay that money.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: These townsfolk are a bunch of idiots. We're offering to be their bodyguards, and they turn us down?
rows.display_text:
「These townsfolk are idiots. We offer to
be their bodyguards, and they turn us
down?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Demanding an outrageous tribute in return is no different from extortion.
rows.display_text:
「Demanding an outrageous tribute in
return is no different from extortion.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: You're a smart one, ain'tcha.
rows.display_text: 「You're a smart one, ain'tcha.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Hyahahahahaha! You're right about that!
rows.display_text: 「Hyahahahahaha! You're right about that!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: So that's how it is, pal. If you don't wanna get hurt, go tell those townsfolk to hurry up and pay.
rows.display_text:
「So that's how it is, pal. If you don't
wanna get hurt, tell the townsfolk to pay
up fast.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The mayor is requesting the Federation forces be deployed, and is considering having you driven out.
rows.display_text:
「The mayor's requesting Federation
forces be deployed, and considering having
you driven out.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Th-the Federation army's coming here!?
rows.display_text: 「Th-the Federation army's coming here!?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: At this point it's only under consideration. But if you withdraw quietly, I expect the request to the military will be called off.
rows.display_text:
「It's only under consideration for now.
But withdraw quietly, and I expect the
request to the military gets called off.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Your lives matter too, don't they. I'm telling you this for your own good... I'd advise you to retreat here.
rows.display_text:
「Your lives matter too. I'm telling you
this for your own good... I'd advise
retreating here.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Y-yeah... guess you're right...
rows.display_text: 「Y-yeah... guess you're right...」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: You idiot! Don't fall for his sweet talk!
rows.display_text:
「You idiot! Don't fall for his sweet
talk!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: It's gotta be a bluff! This continent's outside the New Earth Federation's jurisdiction!
rows.display_text:
「Gotta be a bluff! This continent's
outside the New Earth Federation's
jurisdiction!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: There's no way the Federation army would move for some tiny town in South Ameria!
rows.display_text:
「No way the Federation army would move
for some tiny town in South Ameria!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Is that so?
rows.display_text: 「Is that so?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The New Federation, aiming to expand its power, has been actively absorbing autonomous cities and small nations as part of that effort.
rows.display_text:
「The New Federation, aiming to expand
its power, has been actively absorbing
autonomous cities and small nations.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: You're saying they sold the town out to the Federation just to run us off!?
rows.display_text:
「So they sold the town to the
Federation just to run us off!?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That just means their resolve runs that deep. ...You'd best make your decision quickly.
rows.display_text:
「That just means their resolve runs
deep. ...Best make your decision quickly.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Shut up, you crow bastard! If that's how it is, it's war!
rows.display_text:
「Shut up, you crow bastard! If that's
how it is, it's war!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: We'll burn this town to the ground and skip town before the Federation army ever gets here!
rows.display_text:
「We'll burn this town down and skip out
before the Federation army gets here!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Do something like that, and you'll make an enemy of the New Federation for good.
rows.display_text:
「Do something like that, and you'll make
an enemy of the New Federation for good.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Like I give a damn! It's do-or-die from here!
rows.display_text:
「Like I give a damn! It's do-or-die from
here!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: It seems there's no point talking any further.
rows.display_text:
「It seems there's no point talking any
further.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Wh-what's this!? You wanna fight us now!?
rows.display_text:
「Wh-what's this!? You wanna fight us
now!?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I'm a Negotiator. I came here to negotiate.
rows.display_text:
「I'm a Negotiator. I came here to
negotiate.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I'll come back another day. Until then, I hope you'll have withdrawn.
rows.display_text:
「I'll come back another day. Until then,
I hope you'll have withdrawn.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: You're the one who oughta tell the townsfolk! Tell 'em we mean business!
rows.display_text:
「You're the one to tell the townsfolk!
Tell 'em we mean business!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: If you understand, then get lost already! Consider this our declaration of war!
rows.display_text:
「If you get it, then get lost already!
Consider this our declaration of war!」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: Oh... welcome back, Mr. Roger. So, how did the negotiation go?
rows.display_text:
「Oh... welcome back, Mr. Roger. So, how
did the negotiation go?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Unfortunately, it seems they've abandoned even the ability to weigh gain against loss.
rows.display_text:
「Unfortunately, they seem to have
abandoned even the ability to weigh gain
against loss.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: By hinting at the military's presence, I may have provoked them into striking first.
rows.display_text:
「By hinting at the military's presence, I
may have provoked them to strike first.」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: What a thing to happen! Then what was the point of hiring you as our negotiator!
rows.display_text:
「What a thing to happen! Then what was
the point of hiring you as our negotiator!」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: There's no way the Federation army would come to a backwater like this...! Oh... what am I supposed to do...!?
rows.display_text:
「There's no way the Federation army
would come to a backwater like this...!
Oh... what do I do...!?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Rest assured, Mayor. They're nothing more than thugs frightened by the shadow of the military, after all.
rows.display_text:
「Rest assured, Mayor. They're just thugs
frightened by the shadow of the military.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: If you give them a small amount--say, about one percent of the tribute they're demanding--they'll likely take it and run.
rows.display_text:
「Give them a small amount--about one
percent of the tribute they want--and
they'll likely take it and run.」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: If it can be settled with that little, nothing would please me more...
rows.display_text:
「If it's settled with that little, nothing
would please me more...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I see any job I take on through to the end. I promise to handle this matter with both responsibility and sincerity.
rows.display_text:
「I see any job through to the end. I
promise to handle this with both
responsibility and sincerity.」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: A-all right. Then I'll get the money ready right away.
rows.display_text:
「A-all right. Then I'll get the money
ready right away.」

rows.speaker: Vigilante Leader
rows.en: Wait, Mayor! You mustn't give those bastards any money!
rows.display_text:
「Wait, Mayor! You mustn't give those
bastards any money!」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: It's only one percent of the tribute. If that's enough to buy the town's safety...
rows.display_text:
「It's only one percent of the tribute.
If that buys the town's safety...」

rows.speaker: Vigilante Leader
rows.en: It's not about the amount...! I don't want us to just hand over money without even putting up a fight!
rows.display_text:
「It's not about the amount...! I won't
just hand over money without even
putting up a fight!」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: B-but...
rows.display_text: 「B-but...」

rows.speaker: Vigilante Leader
rows.en: There's nothing to worry about. If they come at us, the militia will handle them.
rows.display_text:
「There's nothing to worry about. If they
attack, the militia will handle them.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: With respect, however much they're thugs, those men make their living by fighting.
rows.display_text:
「With respect, thugs or not, those men
make their living by fighting.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The mayor has judged that if this town's militia fought them, it would amount to marching to their deaths.
rows.display_text:
「The mayor's judged that if this town's
militia fought them, it'd mean marching to
their deaths.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's why you hired me.
rows.display_text: 「That's why you hired me.」

rows.speaker: Vigilante Leader
rows.en: I know that full well. That's exactly why we've hired professionals of our own.
rows.display_text:
「I know that full well. That's why we
hired professionals of our own.」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: You hired bodyguards?
rows.display_text: 「You hired bodyguards?」

rows.speaker: Vigilante Leader
rows.en: They used to be soldiers. Their skills should be the real deal.
rows.display_text:
「They used to be soldiers, so their
skills should be solid.」

rows.speaker: Vigilante Leader
rows.en: That's how it is, Negotiator. Sorry, but leave the rest to us from here.
rows.display_text:
「That's how it is, Negotiator. Sorry, but
leave the rest to us.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: What will you do, Mayor?
rows.display_text: 「What will you do, Mayor?」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: I'm sorry, Mr. Roger. I've decided to choose the path of fighting them, along with everyone else.
rows.display_text:
「I'm sorry, Mr. Roger. I've chosen the
path of fighting them, along with
everyone else.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: You'd waste a life that could be saved?
rows.display_text: 「You'd waste a life that could be saved?」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: It's true that if I left it to you, we might be able to buy the town's safety for next to nothing.
rows.display_text:
「It's true that if I left it to you, we
might buy the town's safety for next to
nothing.」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: But from now on... when a second or third gang of outlaws shows up, we can't keep running away forever.
rows.display_text:
「But from now on... when a second or
third gang shows up, we can't keep
running forever.」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: As mayor, putting the people of this town in danger might be the wrong choice...
rows.display_text:
「As mayor, putting the people of this
town in danger might be the wrong
choice...」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: But I believe that to go on living in this world, we mustn't lose our strength of heart.
rows.display_text:
「But I believe that to live on in this
world, we mustn't lose our strength of
heart.」

rows.speaker: Vigilante Leader
rows.en: Mayor...
rows.display_text: 「Mayor...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I understand. If your resolve runs that deep, there's nothing more for me to say.
rows.display_text:
「I understand. If your resolve runs that
deep, I've nothing more to say.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Allow me to wish you all good fortune in the fight ahead.
rows.display_text:
「Let me wish you all good fortune in
the fight ahead.」

rows.speaker: Vigilante Leader
rows.en: Now that that's settled, let's get the hired help together for a war council.
rows.display_text:
「That settled, let's get the hired help
together for a war council.」

rows.speaker: Mayor
rows.en: Well then, Mr. Roger... I'm sorry, but I'll take my leave now.
rows.display_text:
「Well then, Mr. Roger... I'm sorry, but
I'll take my leave now.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Too bad, Roger.
rows.display_text: 「Too bad, Roger.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: It's not as though the negotiation failed. I'm not bothered by it.
rows.display_text:
「It's not that the negotiation failed.
I'm not bothered by it.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: If anything, you look happy about it.
rows.display_text: 「If anything, you look happy about it.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Since leaving Paradigm City, I've met all sorts of people...
rows.display_text:
「Since leaving Paradigm City, I've met all
sorts of people...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: and among them, the strength of will these townspeople have earns my respect.
rows.display_text:
「and among them, this town's people
show a will that earns my respect.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Before I leave town, I'd like to see the faces of the bodyguards who inspired them to that resolve.
rows.display_text:
「Before I leave town, I'd like to see
the faces of the bodyguards who inspired
their resolve.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Who's there...!?
rows.display_text: 「Who's there...!?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Sorry to startle you. My name is Roger Smith. I work as a Negotiator.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry to startle you. My name is Roger
Smith. I work as a Negotiator.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I thought I'd pay my respects to the people who volunteered to guard this town.
rows.display_text:
「I wanted to pay my respects to those
who volunteered to guard this town.」

rows.speaker: Zwei
rows.en: You're the one who was acting as negotiator with the bandit gang, aren't you?
rows.display_text:
「You're the one who negotiated with the
bandit gang, aren't you?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's right.
rows.display_text: 「That's right.」

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: Don't tell me you came here to complain 'cause we stole your job.
rows.display_text:
「Don't tell me you came here to complain
'cause we stole your job.」

rows.speaker: Sijou
rows.en: Stop talking as if you're mocking him like that.
rows.display_text:
「Stop talking as if you're mocking him
like that.」

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: I meant it as a joke. Don't take it so seriously.
rows.display_text:
「I meant it as a joke. Don't take it so
seriously.」

rows.speaker: Sijou
rows.en: Even if you mean it as a joke, it's rude toward someone you've just met.
rows.display_text:
「Even if you mean it as a joke, it's
rude toward someone you've just met.」

rows.speaker: Cinq
rows.en: Now, now... it's unbecoming to squabble in front of a guest.
rows.display_text:
「Now, now... it's unbecoming to squabble
in front of a guest.」

rows.speaker: Hex
rows.en: Sorry about that... You came all this way to visit, and we go and show you something so unsightly.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry about that... You came all this
way, and we show you something so
unsightly.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's no trouble at all... though you're quite the motley crew, aren't you.
rows.display_text:
「No trouble at all... though you're quite
the motley crew, aren't you.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: To have Titans from the New Federation army, along with ZAFT, the Orb military, Moonrace, and even a member of the Sibe Rail Security Corps...
rows.display_text:
「New Federation Titans, ZAFT, Orb
military, Moonrace, and even a Sibe Rail
Security Corps member, too...」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Every one of us comes with a 'former' attached, though.
rows.display_text:
「Every one of us comes with a 'former'
attached, though.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: How do you mean?
rows.display_text: 「How do you mean?」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: We're Noir 7. A mercenary group made up of people who've left their armies and organizations behind.
rows.display_text:
「We're Noir 7. A mercenary group of
people who left their armies and
organizations behind.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Let's do introductions. I'm Oone... as you can see, a former member of the Titans.
rows.display_text:
「Let's do introductions. I'm Oone... a
former Titans member, as you can see.」

rows.speaker: Zwei
rows.en: I'm Zwei. I used to be with the Dianna Counter.
rows.display_text:
「I'm Zwei. I used to be with the Dianna
Counter.」

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: Name's Trois. Used to be ZAFT, but now I'm one of the outlaws.
rows.display_text:
「Name's Trois. Used to be ZAFT, but now
I'm one of the outlaws.」

rows.speaker: Sijou
rows.en: I'm Sijou. I was formerly a soldier of Orb.
rows.display_text:
「I'm Sijou. I was formerly a soldier of
Orb.」

rows.speaker: Cinq
rows.en: I'm Cinq. I used to work Sibe Rail security.
rows.display_text:
「I'm Cinq. I used to work Sibe Rail
security.」

rows.speaker: Hex
rows.en: Name's Hex. A KLF rider who loves the waves.
rows.display_text:
「Name's Hex. A KLF rider who loves the
waves.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: For a name like Noir 7, there seem to be only six of you...
rows.display_text:
「For a name like Noir 7, there seem to
be only six of you...」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: There's one more--a former Chiram soldier--but he's out on reconnaissance.
rows.display_text:
「One more--a former Chiram soldier--but
he's out on recon.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Leaving your organizations to take up bodyguard work--sounds like there's a story behind that for each of you.
rows.display_text:
「Leaving your organizations for
bodyguard work--sounds like there's a
story behind that for each of you.」

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: Well... that's different for everyone. In my case, I fell for a Natural girl and ran out on my unit.
rows.display_text:
「Well... that's different for everyone. I
fell for a Natural girl and ran out on my
unit.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: What happened to that girl?
rows.display_text: 「What happened to that girl?」

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: She got caught up in the fighting...
rows.display_text: 「She got caught up in the fighting...」

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: That's how it would've gone if this were a drama, but the truth is she was two-timing me, and she up and married some other guy.
rows.display_text:
「That'd be a drama, but the truth is
she two-timed me, and married someone
else.」

rows.speaker: Sijou
rows.en: Honestly... that's what happens when you chase after fleeting pleasures.
rows.display_text:
「Honestly... that's what happens when
you chase after fleeting pleasures.」

rows.speaker: Sijou
rows.en: In my case, I defected in protest against the Seiran family, who run Orb.
rows.display_text:
「In my case, I defected in protest
against the Seirans, who run Orb.」

rows.speaker: Zwei
rows.en: Huh... I'd heard Sijou was a huge fan of Chief Representative Cagalli, and left Orb just to follow after her...
rows.display_text:
「Huh... I'd heard Sijou was a huge fan
of Chief Representative Cagalli and left
Orb just to follow her...」

rows.speaker: Sijou
rows.en: D-don't go making it sound so scandalous, Zwei! I left so that I could bring Chief Representative Cagalli back to Orb and overthrow the Seiran family...
rows.display_text:
「D-don't make it sound scandalous, Zwei!
I left to bring Chief Rep. Cagalli back to
Orb and overthrow the Seirans...」

rows.speaker: Cinq
rows.en: Come on, it's fine. No need to act tough about it now.
rows.display_text:
「Come on, it's fine. No need to act
tough about it now.」

rows.speaker: Cinq
rows.en: For what it's worth, in my case, the operations chief who took over running the security corps took a dislike to me, and I got fired.
rows.display_text:
「For what it's worth, the operations
chief who took over the security corps
disliked me, and I got fired.」

rows.speaker: Zwei
rows.en: I came down to Earth from the Moon, and I left the military because I wanted to see more of Earth's nature.
rows.display_text:
「I came down to Earth from the Moon,
and left the military to see more of
Earth's nature.」

rows.speaker: Hex
rows.en: You're a romantic, Zwei. Well... I punched a superior officer I didn't like, so I'm probably the most troublesome one here.
rows.display_text:
「You're a romantic, Zwei. Well... I
punched a superior I disliked, so I'm
probably the worst offender here.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: That's about the size of it. None of us really have a reason worth bragging about.
rows.display_text:
「That's about the size of it. None of us
really have a reason worth bragging
about.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: And what about you, yourself?
rows.display_text: 「And what about you, yourself?」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Something similar. I just got sick of the military as an organization.
rows.display_text:
「Something similar. I just got sick of
the military as an organization.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Was there a particular reason?
rows.display_text: 「Was there a particular reason?」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: It's this kind of world we live in. I stopped wanting to trust in anything but what I'd seen with my own eyes.
rows.display_text:
「It's this kind of world. I stopped
wanting to trust anything but what I've
seen with my own eyes.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: So that's the story behind you throwing away your elite title...
rows.display_text:
「So that's why you threw away your
elite title...」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: I don't regret it.
rows.display_text: 「I don't regret it.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: It's true that back when I was an elite of the New Earth Federation army, power was everything to me, and I never once thought about a place outside of that.
rows.display_text:
「Back when I was a New Earth Federation
elite, power was everything--I never once
thought of a place outside that.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: But it's precisely because the world is like this that I want to value humanity itself...
rows.display_text:
「But it's exactly because the world's
like this that I want to value humanity
itself...」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: That's why, even after throwing away my title and status, I believe that this place where I stand is the center of the world.
rows.display_text:
「That's why, even without title or
status, I believe this place where I stand
is the center of the world.」

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: There it is, the leader's usual line.
rows.display_text: 「There it is, the leader's usual line.」

rows.speaker: Sijou
rows.en: Well... it was that character of his that drew us together to form this team, though.
rows.display_text:
「Well... it was his character that drew
us together to form this team, though.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: ...From what I can see, the bandit gang has assembled a fair number of Walker Machines.
rows.display_text:
「...From what I can see, the bandit gang
has assembled quite a few Walker
Machines.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Do you think you can win with just the six of you?
rows.display_text:
「Do you think you can win with just the
six of you?」

rows.speaker: Hex
rows.en: Course, it's a piece of cake!... is what I'd like to say, but...
rows.display_text:
「Course, it's a piece of cake!... is what
I'd like to say, but...」

rows.speaker: Zwei
rows.en: By my calculations, it's about fifty-fifty... if anything, I think we might actually be at a disadvantage.
rows.display_text:
「By my calculations, it's about
fifty-fifty... if anything, we might
actually be at a disadvantage.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Do the townspeople know that?
rows.display_text: 「Do the townspeople know that?」

rows.speaker: Cinq
rows.en: We're not con artists. We told them straight before signing the contract.
rows.display_text:
「We're not con artists. We told them
straight before signing the contract.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: And even knowing that, they chose to bet on us.
rows.display_text:
「And even knowing that, they chose to
bet on us.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Then, all of you are...
rows.display_text: 「Then, all of you are...」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: I know what you're getting at. You want to ask why we'd take on a job that puts us at such a disadvantage.
rows.display_text:
「I know what you're getting at. You
want to know why we took a job with
such bad odds.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: The reason's in what I just told you. It's because this town is the center of the world for the people who live here.
rows.display_text:
「The reason's in what I just said. This
town is the center of the world for the
people who live here.」

rows.speaker: Hex
rows.en: It might be a small town to a gang of bandits, but to the people who live here, it's the precious place where they live with their families.
rows.display_text:
「It's a small town to bandits, but to
the people here, it's the precious place
they share with their families.」

rows.speaker: Trois
rows.en: So we got hit right in the heart by these folks who mustered up the courage to protect it. Heh... corny enough to laugh at, huh?
rows.display_text:
「So we got hit right in the heart by
folks brave enough to protect it. Heh...
corny, huh?」

rows.speaker: Sijou
rows.en: But this is our unanimous decision.
rows.display_text: 「But this is our unanimous decision.」

rows.speaker: Zwei
rows.en: Whatever we're lacking in strength, we'll make up for with the townspeople's cooperation and each of us fighting our hardest.
rows.display_text:
「What we lack in strength, we'll cover
with the townspeople's help and each of
us fighting our hardest.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: ...Thank you. I'm glad I got to meet all of you before leaving this town.
rows.display_text:
「...Thank you. I'm glad I got to meet
you all before leaving town.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: This place is about to become a battlefield. You'd best get going soon.
rows.display_text:
「This place is about to become a
battlefield. Best get going soon.」

rows.speaker: Septe
rows.en: It's bad, Leader! The bandits are already making their move!
rows.display_text:
「It's bad, Leader! The bandits are
already making their move!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Sooner than expected... Guess they're desperate too.
rows.display_text:
「Sooner than expected... Guess they're
desperate too.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: A wounded beast, then.
rows.display_text: 「A wounded beast, then.」

rows.speaker: Septe
rows.en: You're that Negotiator, right? Take my advice and get out of here fast.
rows.display_text:
「You're that Negotiator, right? Take my
advice, get out fast.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: So you're the last member of Noir 7.
rows.display_text: 「So you're the last member of Noir 7.」

rows.speaker: Septe
rows.en: Name's Septe. Chiram's militarism started seeming so stupid that I deserted.
rows.display_text:
「Name's Septe. Chiram's militarism started
seeming stupid, so I deserted.」

rows.speaker: Septe
rows.en: We probably won't meet again, but keep it somewhere in the back of your mind that a guy like me existed.
rows.display_text:
「We probably won't meet again, but
remember that a guy like me existed.」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Don't say something so ill-omened, Septe. I don't intend to let a single person die, townsfolk or you guys.
rows.display_text:
「Don't say something so ill-omened,
Septe. I won't let a single person die,
townsfolk or you.」

rows.speaker: Septe
rows.en: Heh... sorry about that. Guess I was getting weak-kneed, which isn't like me.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... sorry. Guess I was getting
weak-kneed, which isn't like me.」

rows.speaker: Cinq
rows.en: Don't sweat it, don't sweat it! Let's just switch gears and get going!
rows.display_text:
「Don't sweat it, don't sweat it! Let's
just switch gears and get going!」

rows.speaker: Hex
rows.en: Let's show 'em...! What Noir 7's really made of!
rows.display_text:
「Let's show 'em...! What Noir 7's really
made of!」

rows.speaker: Ohne
rows.en: Get ready, everyone! We'll meet the bandits head-on just like we planned!
rows.display_text:
「Get ready, everyone! We'll meet the
bandits head-on just like we planned!」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Fighting by my own will, so I can live like a human being...
rows.display_text:
「Fighting by my own will, so I can live
like a human being...」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: The place where you stand on your own two feet is the center of the world, huh...
rows.display_text:
「The place you stand on your own two
feet is the center of the world, huh...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's right. Moved by his words, I too tried to find the truth for myself.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. Moved by his words, I too
tried to find the truth for myself.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's the reason I joined $c, too.
rows.display_text: 「That's the reason I joined $c, too.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: Heh heh... you gave us a real good story there, right at the last minute.
rows.display_text:
「Heh heh... you gave us a good story
there, right at the last minute.」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: For the sake of those people too, we've absolutely got to see the spacetime restoration through.
rows.display_text:
「For their sake too, we've absolutely
got to see the spacetime restoration
through.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: But not everyone in the world's a good person.
rows.display_text:
「But not everyone in the world's a good
person.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: There's plenty of scum in this world too. So what do we do about guys like that?
rows.display_text:
「There's plenty of scum in this world
too. So what do we do about them?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: It doesn't matter whether someone's good or bad... I think we should protect the world for the sake of every single person.
rows.display_text:
「Good or bad doesn't matter... I think
we should protect the world for everyone.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: So that means saving the bad guys too?
rows.display_text: 「So that means saving the bad guys too?」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: I think the world is made up of all those kinds of people put together.
rows.display_text:
「I think the world's made up of all
those kinds of people together.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: That's why I want to protect it. Not for the sake of any one person in particular, but the world that belongs to everyone.
rows.display_text:
「That's why I want to protect it--not
for one person, but the world that
belongs to everyone.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: And on top of that, I'll work to end wars and fight against people who only think of themselves. ...Might sound like empty idealism, though.
rows.display_text:
「And on top of that, I'll work to end
wars and fight the self-serving. ...Might
sound like empty idealism, though.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: What you're trying to say... I get it, Shinn.
rows.display_text:
「What you're trying to say... I get it,
Shinn.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: We're only guides for the spacetime restoration--we're not the creators of the world.
rows.display_text:
「We're just guides for the spacetime
restoration--not the world's creators.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: This whole thing's like a natural disaster. It's no time to be picking and choosing who we save.
rows.display_text:
「This whole thing's like a disaster. It's
no time to pick and choose who we save.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Right. If it's come to this, let's go into it with the mindset of protecting everyone in the world.
rows.display_text:
「Right. Let's go into this with the
mindset of protecting everyone in the
world.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Beating up bad guys can wait. First we've gotta do something about everyone's home.
rows.display_text:
「Beating bad guys can wait. First, we've
got to sort out everyone's home.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Even if this world doesn't have any value worth protecting, we can protect it first and change it afterward.
rows.display_text:
「Even if this world has no value worth
protecting, we can protect it first and
change it after.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Six hours left until the scheduled time for the spacetime restoration, huh...
rows.display_text:
「Six hours left till the spacetime
restoration's scheduled time, huh...」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: There's no more hesitation in me. All that's left is to wait for that moment.
rows.display_text:
「No more hesitation in me. All that's
left is to wait for that moment.」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: We're gathering the feelings of everyone in the world as we head for the Great Singularity.
rows.display_text:
「We're gathering everyone's feelings as
we head for the Great Singularity.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: And then, we'll restore spacetime... I believe there's a new future waiting on the other side of that.
rows.display_text:
「And then, we'll restore spacetime... I
believe a new future waits on the other
side of that.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Wait for me, Eureka... I'll definitely come to get you, no matter what.
rows.display_text:
（Wait for me, Eureka... I'll definitely
come to get you, no matter what.）

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: And then, let's wish for it together. A new world for all of us, and for everyone else too...
rows.display_text:
（And then, let's wish for it together. A
new world for us, and for everyone else
too...）
